packageRules.description: Port of the dependabot substrait group. check_substrait_package_versions.sh requires all three packages to carry the same version, so they have to move together. Exempt from the cooldown: we publish these ourselves, so there is no third-party release to let the ecosystem vet

ruff is declared in both [tool.pixi.dependencies] and .pre-commit-config.yaml, so keep the hook revision in step with the pixi range rather than letting them drift apart in separate PRs. Both are development tooling, so they take the deps-dev scope. Lock file maintenance is excluded: the pep621 manager already refreshes pixi.lock in the regular lock file maintenance PR, and a second grouped branch rewriting the same file would conflict with it
Match the deps-dev scope dependabot used for development dependencies, including the commitlint toolchain in package.json
Changing the supported Python version is a project decision, not a routine bump
This package is published: widen ranges rather than dropping support for versions consumers may still be on. Left at auto, pep621 resolves to replace, which would turn protobuf >=5,<7 into >=7,<8

exclude-newer in pyproject.toml already applies the release-age cooldown to every package uv lock and pixi lock pick. Lock file maintenance has no release date for Renovate to check, so its own gate would never pass
